title: Comparison of endovascular procedures in the lower extremities and iliac arteries with and without the use of the navigation assistance Vascular Navigation PAD
summary: The study examines whether contrast medium can be saved during vascular surgery procedures on arteries with the help of a supporting product. In addition, it is measured whether the X-ray radiation can be reduced compared to the standard method.

interventions.name: Carrying out endovascular procedures on the iliac and leg arteries with the assistence of the navigation assistance Vascular Navigation PAD
Carrying out endovascular procedures on the iliac and leg arteries without the assistence of the navigation assistance Vascular Navigation PAD

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•	Subject has been diagnosed with peripheral arterial disease of the lower limbs or iliac arteries, all clinical stages
•	Subject is eligible for endovascular surgery 
•	Subject provides written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
•	Subject requires bypass surgery or other conventional surgery revascularization
•	Subject has a known contrast agent allergy
•	Subject is pregnant or nursing
•	Subject is unable to consent
